title: The Death of the Seed
english: Of seeds: But if it dies, it bears much fruit. It is evident that the living one dies; and you once set aside eating the things possessed which have the life-giving power.
And the apostle Paul says: That which you sow is not made alive unless it dies (1 Corinthians 15:36); and that which you sow, not the body.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.

title: The Seed and the Body
english: You sow what is about to become, but if you should happen to find a naked grain of wheat or of something else; but God gives it a body, just as He willed. It has also been demonstrated concerning the seeds, how it dies and is made alive (1 Cor 15:36), and that God gives it a body.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.

title: Sacrifice and Holy Meals in the Old Testament
